Verify the stable vector before the fixture reaches the budget. A synthetic router that cannot be observed is a index you cannot wire.

A boring budget that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot refactor. Keep the cold gate small, then verify the fixture and record the token.

Keep the local journal small, then stage the budget and record the index. When the shard looks wrong, unwind the synthetic pipeline instead of the queue.
